snippets.text: EverMind AI's open-source Raven agent system, which builds and evolves a separate harness per model and domain under a host agent, has 5.2k GitHub stars under an Apache 2.0 licence, according to its repository.
snippets.why: Its benchmark claims, such as top SWE-bench results for Raven-Code, come from EverMind's own README and have not been independently tested.
